title: Sur la distribution des nombres premiers
author: J. E. Littlewood
publication: Comptes rendus 158, session of 22 June 1914, pp. 1869–1872
method: Fresh English translation of the full note, visually checked against all four page images; OCR used for discovery only. Reader leaf positions were checked against the printed page headers, rather than inferred from the scan metadata.

coverage.scope: All three source sections, formulas (1)–(12), the comparison internally cited as (13), intervening unnumbered displays, and the author footnote.

interventions.reason: Required by (4)–(6); the independent inequality-direction mismatch is explained, not silently corrected.

interventions.action: Numbered (13) in the rendering because the source refers to it by this number but prints no adjacent number.
Printed choice preserved. Margin explains why index and height cutoffs differ and supplies a corrected finite recurrence step.
Printed reference to the lemma in paragraph 3 preserved; margin identifies the lemma as §2.

proofStatus: The source is a proof outline. All text is rendered; boundary estimates, transfer between counting functions, the non-RH branch, and the strip boundedness theorem are stated dependencies, not claims of completed formal verification.
